content.title: Berkshire Hathaway's future without Buffett: The bull & bear case
content.description:
Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-B, BRK-A) Chairman and CEO Warren Buffett is set to pass over the chief executive reins to his successor and current vice chair Greg Abel on January 1, 2026. Buffett will remain on the company's board as chairman.

FBB Capital Partners Senior Portfolio Manager Mel Casey presents the bull and bear cases for Berkshire shares in 2026 to Josh Lipton.
